description: This file contains a shell script that tests the behavior of Git submodule diff tracking, including setup, modification, removal, and movement of submodules. It defines functions for adding files and committing changes, and runs a series of tests to verify submodule states and diffs.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a Git repository and commits them with a message indicating added files.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Commits specific changes with a standardized message.
